ready_rule: A visible composer signal is required and no higher-priority blocking/auth signal may be present.
auth_rule: Authentication URL/login controls/login-only page signals map to AUTH_REQUIRED.

blocked_rules.RATE_LIMIT: Visible rate-limit/usage-limit signals map to BLOCKED.
blocked_rules.PROTECTION_CHALLENGE: Visible CAPTCHA/human verification/security challenge signals or protection-interstitial titles such as 'Just a moment...' map to BLOCKED.
blocked_rules.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: Visible account disabled/deactivated/suspended signals map to BLOCKED.
blocked_rules.ACCESS_DENIED: Visible access denied/unsupported-region signals map to BLOCKED.

unknown_rule: Any unrecognized or unreadable page fails closed to UNKNOWN and requires operator action.
test_mode: local fixture pages plus live-state-only proof; no prompt submission or Output extraction
